brief: A high-performance screenshot and visual intelligence utility built for developers and power users. Designed with Raycast/Linear minimalism and GeForce HUD fluidity, featuring sub-second capture and 100% offline OCR.
criteria: Success: Instantaneous recognition, unmistakable 45° razor shears silhouette with central sensor aperture, scales flawlessly down to 16 px menu bar tray, and commands prestige in macOS Dock.

concepts.name: The Obsidian Razor
concepts.idea: Symmetrical 45° razor-tapered shears crossing through a central optical sensor aperture.
rationale: Unites physical capture speed ('Snip') with offline optical intelligence ('Sense')
Perfect mathematical 45° symmetry guarantees flawless legibility across macOS Dock and Menu Bar
Deep Obsidian (#0B0D10) monochrome luxury fits alongside Linear, Raycast, and Figma

recommendation: The Obsidian Razor is the definitive mark. It carries maximum symbolic clarity, zero unnecessary ornament, and supreme durability.
next_steps: Integrate into macOS app, dock icon, tray, and studio UI
